title: New class reactive-marangoni, negative: burning pockets moved by their own compressible Marangoni surface flow never self-propel; flow away from heat disperses them, flow toward heat collapses them into still points, flow toward fresh fuel holds one still spot
summary: world.py: c49's burning kinetics (r = A Y T^2/(T^2+Ti^2), fuel regrowing at kF) at a surface whose tension depends on heat and fuel, sigma = -m (mt T - my Y); the surface flow is compressible, u_k = i k sigma_k / (eta (|k| + kd)) (deep-layer response), and advects heat and fuel. Screen (quick.py, seed 0, T=600): normal sign (flow away from heat) m 0.1 leaves 2-4 spots that drift apart, m >= 0.3 disperses every pocket; inverse sign m -0.05 to -0.15 makes compact spots (labkit, seeds 0 and 1: 5 and 13 persistent tracks lasting up to 593 t, 5 and 6 persistent splits, generation 1, at most 1.4-1.5 body lengths moved, the same as the m 0 twin's 1.5-1.9 with 8-14 splits); m -0.6 and -1 collapse heat into 32-56 still point spots (Tmax 3.6-6.9); a fuel-set tension (mt 0, my 0.2-1: flow toward fresh fuel) keeps 0-4 still spots. No setting gives a translating body.

finding.operator: compressible Marangoni surface flow (deep-layer response) driven by the body's own heat or by the fuel it consumes
finding.control: m 0 twin (pack_m0, seeds 0 1) and a sign and strength scan of the heat and fuel couplings
finding.result: inverse m -0.15: max 1.4/1.5 body lengths, 5/6 persistent splits, gen 1; m 0: max 1.5/1.9 body lengths, 8/14 splits, gen 2; m -0.6/-1: 32/56 still collapsed spots; normal m >= 0.3: extinction; fuel-driven: 0-4 still spots

limits: A flow that is the smoothed gradient of the body's own heat is self-attraction or self-repulsion (Keller-Segel-like), which compacts or disperses a spot but has no polar instability; in the reacting thermals the propulsive flow is a vortex pair that the buoyancy torque creates from a horizontal heat gradient, which a scalar surface tension cannot make. The route that might still work is camphor-like: a separate, slowly diffusing surfactant made by the burning, with flow away from it. The strong initial burst kills most pockets in every arm (the same kinetics as the thermals at 128^2), so populations are small; seed 0 only for the screen.
